openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.character: Advisory: The advisor's own session model at xhigh. Planner nodes and wide-breadth foremen use high. Reserve medium for implementation whose diagnosis, architecture, or breadth is still materially ambiguous. Regular bounded builders use Sol medium, including fully locked execution packets. This profile recommends Codex models only.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: The regular workhorse at medium reasoning. Use it for bounded implementation, fully locked execution packets, fresh-context checking, and reduction. For locked packets, it resolves environment and tooling obstacles locally, uses deterministic anchors, and stops and escalates on material ambiguity. Escalate materially ambiguous or wide-breadth implementation to Astra.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna.character: Advisory: The scouting and browser-verification model at max reasoning. Use it for source-linked investigation, integrated browser exercise, and bounded evidence capture. Other semantic roles use Astra or Sol in this profile.
